subject: riotInterceptor
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: corporate riot-control interceptor with a water cannon and neon light bars.
Style: Cyberpunk 2077.

spec.name: Arasaka-Style Riot Interceptor RC-9 'Pacifier'
spec.description: A hulking corporate riot-control interceptor truck in Cyberpunk 2077 style, with a roof-mounted water cannon turret, neon light bars, caged windows and corporate decals.
spec.layout: Low, wide, armoured wedge-nosed truck facing +Z. Front: sloped armoured nose with a pushbar ram, a slim cyan neon light strip across the grille and a hazard-striped bumper. Middle: a raised cabin with a slanted, caged, dark-tinted windscreen, a red-and-blue light bar on the roof front, and side doors with riot-shield panels. Back: a flat deck carrying the water tank, with a rotating water-cannon turret on a ring just behind the cabin, and a rear cage with taillight neon. Six chunky wheels (three per side) in armoured arches sit on the floor. Every surface is dark graphite/matte black with magenta, cyan and yellow neon accents, hazard stripes, grime, panel seams, corporate logos and glowing screens. Style: gritty cyberpunk, blocky, high-contrast, neon glow on light bars, strips, screens and the cannon nozzle ring (use the glow kit).

parts.builds: Lower armoured hull: a loft/frustum-box slab body from y 0.35 to 1.3 with a sloped wedge nose, side skirts, wheel arches cut as dark inset boxes above each wheel, underbody plate, panelled paint (clockwork-style panelled + custom grime paint: dark at the bottom, lighter on top, mud near the arches), hazard-stripe bumper (yellow/black stripes paint) with a pushbar ram frame at the front, tow hooks, a rear bumper with a neon-red taillight strip and a rear cage, side corporate logo decals (SVG stencils) and number plates. Include a thin cyan neon underglow strip along each side.
parts.attaches: Top face at chassisTop carries the cabin, the deck and the tank; arches enclose the wheel joints; nose ends at noseFront.

parts.builds: Armoured cabin on cabinBase: a boxy slanted-roof shell (extruded side profile) with a raked, caged windscreen (dark glass + thin steel grille bars), side windows with mesh cages, riot-shield side doors with handles and white POLICE-style corporate lettering decals, wing mirrors on arms, a roof light bar at roofBar (red and blue emissive segments with a dark housing, glow kit) plus a magenta neon strip along the roof edge, a front cyan neon grille strip and headlights (glowing white-cyan slits), a roof antenna cluster and a small drone-sensor dome. A glowing HUD screen is visible through the windscreen.
parts.attaches: Sits on cabinBase/chassisTop; rear wall ends near z=0.2, in front of turretRing; roof bar at roofBar.

parts.builds: Rear deck behind the cabin: a flat deck plate at deckTop with hazard-striped edges, a large horizontal cylindrical water tank (tankBlue with panel bands, rivet paint, warning labels, a glowing level gauge strip in cyan) on saddle straps at tankMount, pipes and hoses running forward to the turret base, two valves, a rear access ladder, side tool lockers, rear cage frame with neon-red taillight bars and a magenta corporate logo emblem on the rear face, vent grills and exhaust stacks with small glowing heat tips.
parts.attaches: Sits on chassisTop at deckTop and tankMount; its forward end sits just behind the turretRing; pipes end at turretRing.

parts.builds: Rotating water-cannon turret at turretRing: a lathe base ring and a drum on turretYaw (armor paint with panel seams and hazard ring), an armoured housing with sloped sides, a gunner shield with a slit window (glass) and a small glowing targeting screen, and a thick barrel on cannonPitch: a tapered tube with reinforcement bands, a flared nozzle with a glowing cyan ring (glow kit) and a magenta ring behind it, feed hoses curving from the base into the barrel, a side-mounted pressure gauge (clockwork gaugeTexture), small floodlight on top, antenna, and rivets. Barrel points forward (+Z) in a neutral pose, slightly raised.
parts.attaches: Base ring centred on turretRing atop the chassis; rides joints turretYaw and cannonPitch; hose connects to the tank pipes behind it.

parts.builds: Six chunky armoured wheels on joints wheelFL/FR/ML/MR/RL/RR: tyres as faceted cylinders with a tread-block paint and sidewall lettering, rims with bolt rings and a hub dish, a faint neon magenta rim glow ring on each, axle housings, suspension arms and shock absorbers (coil via clockwork coil) tying into the hull at the axle mounts, mudflaps with hazard stripes, and brake discs. Wheel radius 0.55, width 0.5, centres at x ±1.15. Front wheels may be stepped slightly outward.
parts.attaches: Wheel centres at axleFront, axleMid, axleRear heights (y 0.55), x ±1.15; suspension arms meet the hull underside at y ~0.4.
